note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MAU 9; A06b MAU 9; L05 N1968, 12.1): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Mauritius, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident for at least 5 years during the previous 7 years, including 12 months preceding the application. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person is a citizen by naturalisation and voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country.
